if("openai-video"===t){let t,n,s,o,r,l,d,c,u,p;return t=`${a.baseUrl}${a.endpointPath}`,n=`${a.baseUrl}/v1/videos/tasks`,s="@角色1和@角色2在@场景1中聊天，@角色1音频是@角色1的音色",o=[{url:"https://m.jiasuapi.com/example/char1.png",name:"角色1"},{url:"https://m.jiasuapi.com/example/char2.png",name:"角色2"},{url:"https://m.jiasuapi.com/example/scene1.png",name:"场景1"}],r=[{url:"https://m.jiasuapi.com/example/voice1.mp3",name:"角色1的音色"}],l=JSON.stringify({model:a.modelName,prompt:s,duration:5,ratio:"16:9",resolution:"720p",images:o,audios:r},null,2),d=o.map(e=>`        {"url": "${e.url}", "name": "${e.name}"},`).join("\n"),c=r.map(e=>`        {"url": "${e.url}", "name": "${e.name}"},`).join("\n"),u=o.map(e=>`    { url: '${e.url}', name: '${e.name}' },`).join("\n"),p=r.map(e=>`    { url: '${e.url}', name: '${e.name}' },`).join("\n"),"curl"===e?`# 1. 创建任务
curl ${t} \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $${a.apiKeyEnv}" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '${l.replace(/\n/g,"\n     ")}'

# 2. 轮询任务状态（每 3 秒）
curl ${n}/$TASK_ID \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $${a.apiKeyEnv}"`
